name: deBasement
description: Born from LA's DIY queer rave scene, deBasement fuses Alli Logout's punk confrontation (frontperson of Special Interest) and Margo XS's production fluency (Kim Petras collaborator and in-demand DJ) into something hard-hitting and deliberately queer. Their debut EP landed with tracks like Front Left Speaker and F.F.F.TDJ already circulating among the people who shape what gets played next (Bambii, A. G. Cook, Juliana Huxtable). The second EP follows in early 2026, representing the cutting edge of queer electronic music at the intersection of punk aggression and club culture.
